reason: 该插件的主要面向功能是作为 DeepSeek Harness 的连接授权适配器，将 Tailscale Serve 注入的身份与能力信息用于访问控制；依据 README 的实现描述和包元数据，可保守归类为外部服务集成类型，核心能力是基于 allowlist 与 capability 的连接请求鉴权与拦截，不涉及内容生成或通用办公流程自动化。

summaries.zh: 该插件是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Tailscale Serve 认证适配器，依据 Tailscale 用户身份与能力头对连接请求进行规则化鉴权。
summaries.en: This plugin is a Tailscale Serve authentication adapter for DeepSeek Harness that enforces connection request authorization using Tailscale user identity and app-capability headers.

capabilities: Validates Tailscale identity and capability headers for request authorization.
Supports allowlist and capability-based access rules for DSH connection requests.
Uses fail-closed behavior when required authorization inputs are missing or invalid.

reasons.code: README states this package is a Tailscale Serve authentication adapter for dsh-client-connection-authz and describes use of Tailscale-User-Login, Tailscale-User-Name, and Tailscale-App-Capabilities for authorization.
Configuration in README defines environment variables for allowed logins and required regular/admin capabilities, and notes startup failure when allowlist is empty.
Package manifest declares DSH bundle patch integration and dependency wiring for the DSH authz plugin, confirming plugin/runtime integration role.
Repository metadata shows a public, active plugin package with explicit Node/TS build scripts and tests, indicating distributed executable plugin artifact.
